about:
OnTenn Automotive USA-LLC operates from Columbia, Tennessee. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides a suite of manufacturing and supply-chain services including lean manufacturing, just-in-time delivery, engineering and project management, logistics and warehousing, quality containment, product certification sorting, and adaptive assembly manufacturing. It also operates a one-stop sorting service. The company describes its offerings as manufacturing excellence, warehousing, quality sorting, material management, and logistics for both short- and long-term engagements. Its technical staff is noted to have capability and experience across these areas. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

OnTenn serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) with just-in-time delivery, emphasizing automotive-sector customers as suggested by its name. The company states it supplies OEMs "just in time" and with the highest quality rating.

OnTenn describes its business model as "truly unique," aimed at delivering significant cost reductions while maintaining the highest performance. It emphasizes reducing costs, improving quality, and ensuring customers receive exactly what they require.
